_why: A document that indexes its own directory is opting into completeness: if it omits a file, the reader has no way to know the list is short, because a short index and a complete one look identical. Coverage is declared here rather than detected, because detection mis-classifies. Local link resolution runs over every other document. A governed projection whose relative links resolve only after materialization into its consumer tree is exempt only at an exact content digest; changing any byte invalidates the exemption.

external_link_contexts.reason: Template links are resolved in the generated consumer repository, and placeholder targets deliberately do not exist in skills-shared.
Governed projection links resolve from the ix-agy checkout after materialization, not from the skills-shared source directory.
